title: Criminal intimidation
old_text: Section 503 defined criminal intimidation; Section 506 punished it (up to 2 yrs / 7 yrs); Section 507 dealt with anonymous communication.
new_text: Consolidates criminal intimidation definition, baseline punishment, aggravated threats to cause death or grievous hurt, and anonymous threats.
punishment_old: Basic: up to 2 years, or fine, or both; threat of death/grievous hurt: up to 7 years; anonymous: additional 2 years
punishment_new: Basic: up to 2 years, or fine, or both; threat of death or grievous hurt: up to 7 years, or fine, or both; anonymous threat: up to 2 additional years
explanation: BNS Section 351 consolidates IPC Sections 503, 506, and 507 into an integrated criminal intimidation statute. Threatening any person with injury to their person, reputation, or property to compel them to do or abstain from doing any act carries up to 2 years, or up to 7 years for lethal threats.

title: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of the peace
old_text: Intentionally insulting, and thereby giving provocation to any person, intending or knowing it will cause him to break the public peace.
new_text: Intentionally insulting and provoking any person, knowing it is likely to cause breach of public peace or commission of an offence.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
explanation: BNS Section 352 replaces IPC Section 504 for intentional verbal insults calculated to provoke violent altercations or breaches of public order. The essential requirement is intentional provocation likely to induce violent retaliation.

title: Statements conducing to public mischief
old_text: Publishing or circulating statements, rumours or reports causing military mutiny, public fear, or communal enmity.
new_text: Publishing, circulating or broadcasting statements, false news, rumours or reports intending or likely to incite armed rebellion, public panic, or communal animosity.
punishment_old: General: up to 3 years, or fine, or both; in place of worship: up to 5 years and fine
punishment_new: General: up to 3 years, or fine, or both; in place of worship: up to 5 years and fine
explanation: BNS Section 353 replaces IPC Section 505 for disseminating provocative statements, hate speech, viral rumors, and reports causing public disorder or communal animosity. It includes digital and social media broadcasts.

title: Act caused by inducing person to believe that he will be rendered an object of Divine displeasure
old_text: Voluntarily causing or attempting to cause any person to do or omit anything by inducing belief that they will become object of Divine displeasure.
new_text: Coercing or inducing any person to do or omit an act by inducing belief that they will become an object of divine displeasure or spiritual curse.
punishment_old: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both
punishment_new: Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both
explanation: BNS Section 354 replaces IPC Section 508 protecting citizens against superstitious blackmail, occult intimidation, or threats of spiritual excommunication and divine retribution.

title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman
old_text: Uttering any word, making any sound or gesture, or exhibiting any object with intent to insult the modesty of a woman, or intruding on privacy.
new_text: Uttering any word, making sound or gesture, exhibiting any object or intruding upon privacy intending to insult modesty of a woman, with community service option.
punishment_old: Simple imprisonment up to 3 years, and fine
punishment_new: Simple imprisonment up to 3 years, and fine, or with community service
explanation: BNS Section 355 replaces IPC Section 509 protecting women from verbal harassment, stalking gestures, and privacy intrusions. The BNS introduces community service as an alternative sentencing discretion alongside imprisonment and fine.

title: Defamation
old_text: Defamation defined in Section 499 with 10 exceptions; punished under Section 500 (up to 2 years or fine), 501 (printing), 502 (sale).
new_text: Consolidates defamation definition, exceptions, printing, and circulation, with community service explicitly added as an alternative punishment.
punishment_old: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
punishment_new: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both, or with community service
explanation: BNS Section 356 consolidates IPC Sections 499 through 502 into a single unified defamation clause while preserving the historic statutory exceptions. Crucially, the BNS introduces community service as an explicit sentencing option for criminal defamation.

title: Misconduct in public by a drunken person
old_text: Appearing in any public place or trespassing while in a state of intoxication and conducting oneself to cause annoyance.
new_text: Appearing in a public place intoxicated and causing annoyance to any person, with community service option and revised fine.
punishment_old: Simple imprisonment up to 24 hours, or fine up to Rs. 10, or both
punishment_new: Simple imprisonment up to 24 hours, or fine up to Rs. 1,000, or both, or with community service
explanation: BNS Section 357 replaces IPC Section 510. The colonial 10-rupee fine ceiling has been elevated to Rs. 1,000, and community service has been introduced as an innovative reformative penalty for public drunkenness and rowdyism.
